phrases: 表示过去习惯性的动作或状态，现在已不再如此
I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
我小时候经常乘飞机旅行。
My parents used to live in South America.
我父母过去住在南美洲。
A flight attendant would take charge of me.
I am used to travelling by air.
Only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
我只曾在一次感到害怕。
The plane was slowly gaining height.
The plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
飞机突然掉头飞回机场。
A flight attendant told us to keep calm.
乘务员告诉我们保持冷静。
Get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
飞机一着陆就安静地下飞机。
飞机上的每个人都很担心。
We were curious to find out what had happened.
我们好奇想知道发生了什么事。

grammar.f: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.d: used to表示过去经常发生的动作或存在的状态，而现在不再如此 用于描述过去的习惯、状态，与现在形成对比
ex: I used to travel by air a great deal.
我过去经常乘飞机旅行。
My parents used to live in South America.
我父母过去住在南美洲。

grammar.k: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
grammar.f: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻正在进行的动作被另一突然发生的动作打断 when引导的短句通常表示突发情况，when可理解为'就在这时'
ex: We were flying low over the city when the plane suddenly turned round.
我们正在城市上空低飞，这时飞机突然掉头。
I was reading a book when the phone rang.
我正在看书，突然电话响了。

grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作 用于描述过去的过去，常与after、before、when等连用，或用于宾语从句中
ex: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted.
警察已被告知飞机上被安置了一颗炸弹。
After we had landed, the plane was searched.
我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查。

patterns.p: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
o: I used to travel by air a great deal.
我过去经常乘飞机旅行。
im: She used to live in Paris.
He used to smoke, but now he doesn't.
他过去抽烟，但现在不抽了。

patterns.p: 主语 + be used to + doing sth
o: I am used to travelling by air.
im: She is used to getting up early.
They are used to living in a big city.

patterns.p: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
o: We were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height, when the plane suddenly turned round.
我们正在城市上空低飞并缓慢爬升，突然飞机掉头了。
im: I was walking home when it started to rain.
我正走回家，突然开始下雨了。
She was cooking dinner when the doorbell rang.
她正在做晚饭，突然门铃响了。

o: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查。
im: After I had finished my homework, I watched TV.
我完成作业之后看了电视。
After he had left, we started to clean the room.
他离开之后，我们开始打扫房间。
